main_body: Round leafy canopy dome on a short brown trunk with flared roots
top_band: Canopy top rows 2-4 at x=8 are light green (L148-178), but at the centre column x=16 the top has no distinct light band (L122 then 76); the lit crown shades gradually into darker foliage
evidence: The organic canopy is a lit dome with a lighter crown and darker underside; the trunk and roots read as a vertical south face. It is not a flat elevation or a plan. There is no hard top plane, which is acceptable for foliage. Passes as a rounded 3/4 form.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 427-567 colours and a median of about 108 per tile for the references. The leaf clumps are chunky and quantised to a few greens, and the trunk has only 2-3 browns with little bark grain. The outlines are tinted dark green or brown and there are no flat-fill blocks, which is good. Even so, the piece is far thinner and less textured than the Beodeul trees.
